svg.title: Output DataFrame structure and column naming convention
svg.desc: The output DataFrame has 100 rows and 4 columns following the project DAG-aligned naming convention with double underscores separating the DAG node family MOM the ticker symbol the computation name cumret and the window size in days; the diagram decomposes one column name into its four labeled parts and then shows horizontal bars for all four output columns with the warm-up NaN region rendered in coral on the left and the valid region in teal on the right, with the 5-day window columns having only 4 NaN rows and the 21-day window columns having 20 NaN rows.
svg.text: Column-name anatomy (each part separated by a double underscore):
All four output columns and where each one becomes valid (100 rows total, left to right):
Rows 0–3 are NaN in every column (the strict assertion).
Rows 21–99 are finite in every column (the post-warm-up assertion).
